headline: Breaking News! BI Rate Naik Jadi 6%
summary: Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate to 6% at its November 2026 board meeting, its third increase after May and June. The move aims to stabilise the rupiah and inflation.
why: Bank Indonesia sets the country's policy rate, which shapes borrowing costs, the rupiah and inflation expectations for Southeast Asia's largest economy.
why_moved: The rate increase to 6% was made to stabilise the rupiah and inflation, and the rupiah closed stronger after the decision.
